影响酶活性的条件 · 3D 互动课件: Conditions Affecting Enzyme Activity · 3D Interactive Lesson
人教版 必修1 第5章第1节「降低化学反应活化能的酶」· 探究·实践「影响酶活性: PEP Biology Required Book 1 · Ch. 5 Sec. 1 "Enzymes Lower the Activation Energy of Chemical Reactions" · Inquiry and Practice "Conditions Affecting Enzyme Activity"
温度、pH 偏离最适 → 活性降低；过酸过碱或温度过高 → 永久失活: Temperature or pH away from the optimum → lower activity; too acidic, too basic or too hot → permanent inactivation
同一支酶，为什么放进沸水里就再也救不回来，放进冰水里却还能醒过来？: Why can't an enzyme be saved after being put in boiling water, yet it recovers after being put in ice water?
温度与 pH 是自变量，其余条件全部固定: Temperature and pH are the independent variables; all other conditions are fixed
一定条件下酶所催化某一化学反应的速率: The rate of a chemical reaction catalyzed by an enzyme under given conditions
最适条件最高，偏高偏低都明显降低: Highest at the optimum, clearly lower above and below
低温只降活性；过酸过碱与高温破坏结构: Low temperature only lowers activity; too acidic, too basic or too hot destroys the structure
三个实验站 + 一个放大视窗: Three experiment stations + one magnified window
整体 · 一张实验台上三组对照，旁边放大到酶与底物: Overview · three controlled comparisons on one bench, with a magnified view of enzyme and substrate beside them
改一个条件，看颜色、气泡、读数和曲线一起动: Change one condition and watch the color, bubbles, readings and curves move together
全对！温度与 pH 两条曲线、可逆与永久失活你都分清了。: All correct! You can tell apart the temperature and pH curves, and reversible versus permanent inactivation.
建议回看主线：先看两条曲线（最适最高），再看「处理过还能不能回来」这三步。: Suggested review of the main thread: first the two curves (highest at the optimum), then the three steps on "can it come back after treatment".
温度站：保温后加碘液 —— 深蓝 = 淀粉还在: Temperature station: add iodine after incubation; dark blue = starch remains
pH 站：气泡快慢 = 分解快慢（示意倍数）: pH station: bubble rate = decomposition rate (schematic multiple)
处理与回温台：先处理 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ 测: Treatment and rewarming bench: treat for 10 min first, then return to 37 ℃ to measure
示意放大：凹槽 = 活性位点，形状与底物相配: Magnified view: the groove = active site, shaped to match the substrate
这支酶在 pH 2 里泡过 10 min：永久失活: This enzyme sat in pH 2 for 10 min: permanently inactivated
两支试管各 2 mL 3% 淀粉溶液 + 2 mL 2% 淀粉酶溶液：一支固定泡: Two test tubes, each 2 mL 3% starch solution + 2 mL 2% amylase solution: one fixed in a 37 ℃ control cup, one in an adjustable water bath (0–70 ℃); add iodine after incubation and look at the color
三支试管各 2 mL 3% H₂O₂：pH 7 对照 / 可调 pH 实验 /: Three test tubes, each 2 mL 3% H₂O₂: pH 7 control / adjustable-pH test / blank with distilled water only; add 2 drops of 20% liver homogenate to each and compare bubbling rates
一支先在 0 ℃ 或 90 ℃ 里放过 10 min 的淀粉酶试管，现在站在 3: An amylase tube that has just spent 10 min at 0 ℃ or 90 ℃, now standing in a 37 ℃ warm-water cup; beside it the ice-water and hot-water cups just used
有凹槽的酶团块咬住 6 颗珠的淀粉长链，切成 3 条 2 颗珠的麦芽糖；凹槽形状: A grooved enzyme blob grips a 6-bead starch chain and cuts it into 3 two-bead maltose pieces; groove shape = substrate shape (schematic magnification)
教材只给了一张材料清单，这些东西摆成什么样的实验才说得清？: The textbook only gives a list of materials: how should they be set up so the experiment is clear?
四个单元都在：两支试管泡在两个水浴杯里、三支 H₂O₂ 试管、三个杯子加一支「回: All four units are present: two tubes in two water-bath cups, three H₂O₂ tubes, three cups plus a "rewarming" tube, and a magnified circular window above the bench. Main reading 100.0 %
酶活性 = 一定条件下酶所催化某一化学反应的速率: Enzyme activity = the rate of a chemical reaction catalyzed by an enzyme under given conditions
2% 淀粉酶 · 3% 淀粉 · 3% H₂O₂ · 20% 肝脏研磨液 · 碘: 2% amylase · 3% starch · 3% H₂O₂ · 20% liver homogenate · iodine solution · 0.01 mol/L HCl and NaOH
三个站对应教材 p.83 的分工建议：淀粉酶测温度（碘液显色）、过氧化氢酶测 p: The three stations follow the division suggested on textbook p.83: amylase for temperature (iodine color), catalase for pH (bubbles), each station watching its own observation.
每站都有对照管，而且只有要测的那一个变量不同 —— 这就是变量控制。: Each station has a control tube, and only the variable being tested differs; that is variable control.
读数把「颜色深不深、气泡多不多」换成一个 0–100 的数，才比得出差多少。: The reading turns "how dark the color, how many bubbles" into a number from 0 to 100, so differences can be compared.
去掉对照：看不出颜色变浅是酶的功劳，还是本来就会变。: Without controls you can't tell whether the color fading is the enzyme's doing or would have happened anyway.
实验设计题常问「自变量是什么、因变量怎么检测、其余条件怎么控制」。: Experimental design questions often ask "what is the independent variable, how is the dependent variable detected, how are other conditions controlled".
教材的材料清单要摆成「一个变量一组对照」：测温度用淀粉酶加碘液，测 pH 用过氧: The textbook's materials list must be arranged as "one variable, one controlled comparison": amylase with iodine for temperature, catalase bubbles for pH; then a separate check: can a treated enzyme recover?
同一支酶，为什么换一个水温，碘液的颜色就不一样了？: Same enzyme: why does the iodine color differ when the water temperature changes?
把水浴从 37 ℃ 拖到 0 ℃（冰水），盯住碘液颜色和主读数；再拖到 70 ℃: Drag the water bath from 37 ℃ to 0 ℃ (ice water) and watch the iodine color and main reading; then drag it to 70 ℃ to see the other end
水浴从 37 ℃ 拖到 0 ℃：活性由 100.0 % 掉到 4.2 %，碘液由: Water bath from 37 ℃ to 0 ℃: activity drops from 100.0 % to 4.2 % and iodine goes from "no blue" to dark blue (starch not fully hydrolyzed); at 70 ℃ only 7.2 % is left. Throughout the textbook's 35–40 ℃ range it is ≥ 95 %
淀粉水解 → 麦芽糖；淀粉 + 碘 → 蓝: Starch hydrolysis → maltose; starch + iodine → blue
3% 淀粉溶液 2 mL + 2% 淀粉酶溶液 2 mL · 保温后加碘液: 2 mL 3% starch solution + 2 mL 2% amylase solution · add iodine after incubation
两支管只有水浴温度不同：酶量、淀粉量、保温时间全都一样。: The two tubes differ only in water-bath temperature: enzyme amount, starch amount and incubation time are all the same.
颜色来自「碘液 + 淀粉」，不是酶的颜色 —— 不显蓝说明淀粉已经被水解完了。: The color comes from "iodine + starch", not from the enzyme; no blue means the starch has been fully hydrolyzed.
测温度为什么不用过氧化氢酶？教材 p.77 的 2 号管只放在 90 ℃ 水浴里: Why not use catalase for temperature? Tube 2 on textbook p.77, placed only in a 90 ℃ water bath with no catalyst, also bubbles: heating alone decomposes H₂O₂, so you can't tell who made the bubbles (inferred from the textbook).
去掉温度这一站：学生只会背「温度影响酶活性」，说不出「有一个最适温度、两侧都掉」: Skip the temperature station and students only recite "temperature affects enzyme activity" without being able to say "there is an optimum and activity falls on both sides".
常考「最适温度两侧活性都下降」；也要分清「低温时活性低」和「失活」不是一回事。: Often tested: "activity falls on both sides of the optimum temperature"; also distinguish "low activity at low temperature" from "inactivation".
其他条件相同时，温度偏高或偏低酶活性都明显降低；最适温度在教材给的动物酶区间 3: With other conditions the same, enzyme activity drops clearly whether the temperature is too high or too low; the optimum lies within the textbook's 35–40 ℃ range for animal enzymes (set to 37 ℃ in this lesson, with activity recorded as 100 %).
把溶液调酸，气泡为什么几乎不冒了？: Why does bubbling nearly stop when the solution is made acidic?
把溶液从 pH 6.8 拖到 pH 2，看三支管的气泡与主读数；再拖到 pH 1: Drag the solution from pH 6.8 to pH 2 and watch the bubbles in the three tubes and the main reading; then drag to pH 12 to see the basic side
pH 从 6.8 拖到 2：活性 100.0 % → 0.1 %，气泡先后停下，: pH from 6.8 to 2: activity 100.0 % → 0.1 %, bubbles stop one after another, bubble-rate reading 1.00× → 0.00×; at 12 only 0.0 % is left
3% H₂O₂ 各 2 mL + 2 滴 20% 肝脏研磨液 · 0.01 mo: 2 mL 3% H₂O₂ each + 2 drops of 20% liver homogenate · pH adjusted with 0.01 mol/L HCl and NaOH
三支管只有 pH 与「有没有酶」不同：pH 7 对照、可调 pH 实验、加蒸馏水: The three tubes differ only in pH and "enzyme or not": pH 7 control, adjustable-pH test, distilled-water blank.
气泡是 H₂O₂ 分解放出的 O₂；没有酶的那支几乎不冒泡，说明气泡确实来自酶。: The bubbles are O₂ from H₂O₂ decomposition; the tube without enzyme barely bubbles, showing the bubbles really come from the enzyme.
去掉 pH 这一站：学生会以为 pH 只分强弱，不知道它也有最适值。: Skip the pH station and students think pH only matters as "strong or weak", not that it also has an optimum.
常与温度并列考「酶为什么需要适宜条件」；胃蛋白酶最适 pH 1.5 是唯一的单点: Often tested alongside temperature as "why enzymes need suitable conditions"; pepsin's optimum pH of 1.5 is the one exception.
其他条件相同时，pH 偏高或偏低酶活性都明显降低；最适 pH 在教材给的动物酶区: With other conditions the same, enzyme activity drops clearly whether the pH is too high or too low; the optimum lies within the textbook's 6.5–8.0 range for animal enzymes (set to 6.8 in this lesson).
在 90 ℃ 里放过 10 分钟的酶，回到 37 ℃ 还能干活吗？: An enzyme that spent 10 minutes at 90 ℃: can it still work back at 37 ℃?
把「预处理」拨到 90 ℃：这支酶先在 90 ℃ 里放了 10 min，现在回到: Switch "Pretreatment" to 90 ℃: this enzyme first spent 10 min at 90 ℃ and is now measured back at 37 ℃
回到 37 ℃、pH 6.8 下活性 0.0 %、碘液深蓝、状态读「永久失活」；: Back at 37 ℃ and pH 6.8, activity is 0.0 %, iodine dark blue, status "permanently inactivated"; in the magnified window the enzyme's groove has collapsed shut
高温 → 空间结构遭到破坏 → 永久失活: High temperature → spatial structure destroyed → permanent inactivation
90 ℃ 水浴 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8 测: 90 ℃ water bath for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
回来的是同一个 37 ℃，唯一的区别是「之前被处理过」。: It's back at the same 37 ℃; the only difference is that it was treated before.
0.0 % 不是「测不出来」，是这支酶已经没有活性了。: 0.0 % isn't "unmeasurable"; this enzyme simply has no activity left.
读数「永久失活」、碘液的深蓝、放大窗里闭合的凹槽，是同一件事的三种写法。: The "permanently inactivated" reading, the dark blue iodine and the closed groove in the magnified window are three ways of writing the same thing.
去掉这一步：学生会把「高温活性低」和「低温活性低」当成一回事，于是写出「低温也会: Skip this step and students treat "low activity when hot" and "low activity when cold" as the same, and wrongly conclude that "low temperature also inactivates enzymes".
「高温使酶变性失活、不可恢复」是必考句，也常问「酶制剂为什么不能煮沸」。: "High temperature denatures and inactivates enzymes irreversibly" is a must-know sentence; also asked: "why can't enzyme preparations be boiled".
温度过高会使酶的空间结构遭到破坏，使酶永久失活 —— 回到最适温度也恢复不了。: Excessive temperature destroys the enzyme's spatial structure and inactivates it permanently; returning to the optimum temperature can't restore it.
A5.3、A7.2、B2.1 常数 DENAT + D4: A5.3, A7.2, B2.1 constant DENAT + D4
在 0 ℃ 里冻了 10 分钟，它为什么还能醒过来？: Frozen at 0 ℃ for 10 minutes, why can it still wake up?
把「预处理」拨到 0 ℃：先在冰水里放 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ 测，与上: Switch "Pretreatment" to 0 ℃: first 10 min in ice water, then measured back at 37 ℃; compare with the previous setting
回到 37 ℃、pH 6.8 下活性 100.0 %，与「未处理」完全一样，碘液: Back at 37 ℃ and pH 6.8, activity is 100.0 %, exactly as untreated, and iodine shows no blue; in the magnified window the groove is undeformed, it just moved slowly before
低温 → 活性很低，但空间结构稳定 → 可恢复: Low temperature → very low activity, but stable spatial structure → recoverable
0 ℃ 冰水 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8 测: 0 ℃ ice water for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
低温改的是「反应有多快」，不是「酶还在不在」。: Low temperature changes how fast the reaction goes, not whether the enzyme survives.
100.0 % 与未处理的 100.0 % 一模一样 —— 这就是「可恢复」的判: 100.0 % is exactly the same as untreated 100.0 %; that's the criterion for "recoverable".
和第 4 步对着看：同一个读数、两种命运，区别只在处理温度。: Compare with step 4: the same reading, two fates, the only difference being the treatment temperature.
去掉这一步：学生会把冰箱当成「毁酶」的地方，也说不出酶制剂为什么要冷藏。: Skip this step and students think a refrigerator "destroys enzymes" and can't say why enzyme preparations are refrigerated.
「低温活性低但结构稳定、可恢复」常在选择题里与高温对调来考。: "Low temperature: low activity but stable structure, recoverable" is often swapped with high temperature in multiple-choice questions.
在 0 ℃ 左右时酶的活性很低，但空间结构稳定，在适宜的温度下酶的活性会升高 —: Around 0 ℃ enzyme activity is very low but the spatial structure is stable, and activity rises again at a suitable temperature; low temperature isn't inactivation, so enzyme preparations are best stored cold.
A5.3、A7.1、B2.1 常数 DENAT + D4: A5.3, A7.1, B2.1 constant DENAT + D4
酶到底把淀粉怎么了？: What exactly does the enzyme do to the starch?
点一下台面上方那个放大圆窗，看酶怎么咬住淀粉链: Click the magnified circular window above the bench and watch how the enzyme grips the starch chain
窗里：有凹槽的酶团块咬住 6 颗珠的淀粉长链，切成 3 条 2 颗珠的短链；活性: In the window: a grooved enzyme blob grips a 6-bead starch chain and cuts it into 3 two-bead short chains; the higher the activity, the more often it cuts. Switch back to step 4's 90 ℃ setting and the groove collapses shut on the spot and never binds again
酶靠空间结构（活性位点）与底物结合: Enzymes bind substrates through their spatial structure (the active site)
酶不是把淀粉「搬走」，是把长链切成短链。: The enzyme doesn't "carry away" the starch; it cuts long chains into short ones.
凹槽（活性位点）的形状要与底物的形状对上，这才叫锁-钥匙。: The shape of the groove (active site) must match the shape of the substrate; that's what lock and key means.
低温时凹槽没坏，只是酶和底物都动得慢，碰上的机会就少。: At low temperature the groove isn't damaged; enzyme and substrate just move slowly and meet less often.
去掉这一步：可逆与不可逆只能靠背，学生说不出「为什么高温就回不来」。: Skip this step and reversible vs irreversible can only be memorized; students can't say why heat is irreversible.
「酶的空间结构决定活性」是解释一切影响因素的根，简答题常要这一句。: "An enzyme's spatial structure determines its activity" is the root explanation for every factor; short-answer questions often need this sentence.
酶靠形状干活：凹槽的形状与底物相配，底物嵌进去才被切开。空间结构一破坏，凹槽没了: Enzymes work by shape: the groove matches the substrate, and the substrate is cut only when it fits in. Once the spatial structure is destroyed the groove is gone, and so is the activity; that's what "permanent inactivation" looks like.
把这支酶泡在过酸的溶液里十分钟，再调回最适 pH，它还干活吗？: Soak this enzyme in an overly acidic solution for ten minutes, then return it to the optimum pH: does it still work?
把「预处理」拨到过酸：这支酶先在 pH 2 里放了 10 min，现在回到最适的: Switch "Pretreatment" to too acidic: this enzyme first spent 10 min at pH 2 and is now measured at the optimum 37 ℃ / pH 6.8; then try dragging the pH around yourself
回到 37 ℃、pH 6.8 下活性 0.0 %、气泡 0.00×、状态读「永久: Back at 37 ℃ and pH 6.8, activity is 0.0 %, bubbles 0.00×, status "permanently inactivated"; dragging pH from 2 to 12 and back to 6.8 still gives 0.0 %. The "too basic" setting likewise gives 0.0 %
过酸、过碱 → 空间结构遭到破坏 → 永久失活: Too acidic or too basic → spatial structure destroyed → permanent inactivation
pH 2（或 pH 12）处理 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8: Treated at pH 2 (or pH 12) for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
错误操作就在这一步：酶被泡在没调好 pH 的溶液里 → 过酸过碱 → 永久失活: The wrong action is in this step: the enzyme is soaked in a solution whose pH wasn't adjusted → too acidic or basic → permanent inactivation → still 0.0 % back at 6.8 (untreated is 100.0 %).
现象与读数一起变：气泡 0.00×、放大窗里凹槽塌陷闭合、状态读「永久失活」。: Observations and readings change together: bubbles 0.00×, the groove in the magnified window collapses shut, status "permanently inactivated".
想接着做要「复位本步」或把预处理拨回「未处理」—— 那等于换一支新鲜酶。: To carry on you must "reset this step" or switch the pretreatment back to "untreated", which amounts to using a fresh enzyme.
去掉这一步：学生会把过酸过碱当成「可逆的降低」，在实验报告里写「pH 调回 7: Skip this step and students treat too acidic or basic as a "reversible decrease" and write in lab reports that "it recovered when pH was set back to 7".
常与高温并列考「哪些条件使酶变性失活、能不能恢复」；这里的后果是归零，不是偏高偏: Often tested alongside high temperature: "which conditions denature and inactivate enzymes, and can they recover"; the consequence here is zero, not just higher or lower.
过酸、过碱会使酶的空间结构遭到破坏，使酶永久失活；它和温度过高是同一种后果，调回: Too acidic or too basic conditions destroy the enzyme's spatial structure and inactivate it permanently; the consequence is the same as excessive heat, and returning to the optimum can't save it.
考核：把这个酶的活性调到 95 % 以上: Assessment: bring this enzyme's activity above 95 %
把温度和 pH 同时调到最适、预处理留在「未处理」，让活性 ≥ 95 % 并保持: Set temperature and pH both to the optimum and leave pretreatment at "untreated", get activity ≥ 95 % and hold for 15 seconds; partway through the water bath will be raised to 60 ℃
达标横幅「最适条件复现成功」；水浴被抬到 60 ℃ 时活性掉到 24.8 %，要: Pass banner "Optimum conditions reproduced"; when the bath is raised to 60 ℃ activity falls to 24.8 %, and you must drag it back to 35–40 ℃
